name: Heather Pappa
description: My Savior's love compels me to serve Him joyfully through children's ministry in Guatemala.
bio: Sending Church: Celebration Community Church, Celebration, FL Ministry Started: 1988 Duration: Full-Time About I am blessed to have been following Christ for many years and am constantly amazed by His great love, grace, and mercy toward me. My Savior's love compels me to serve Him joyfully through children's ministry. It has been my privilege to serve children in the local church both in the United States and in Guatemala for the past 25 years. Ministry I will be serving Charlie's Lunch Ministries in their feeding centers and medical clinics. Charlie's Lunch seeks to meet both physical and spiritual needs by partnering with national churches and pastors to provide hot, nutritious meals alongside Biblical instruction. Personal Message Thank you so much for joining me in caring for the least of these (Matthew 25:31-40).
